cli.description: AI agent workflow for any project.
cmd.init: Set up a new project and write its AGENTS.md.
cmd.adopt: Bring an existing repo into Gait.
cmd.start: Create the branch and plan for a change.
cmd.continue: Show the current branch's plan and progress.
cmd.finish: Open the PR and remove the plan.
cmd.doctor: Check the agent, adapter and hooks.
arg.force: Replace files Gait did not create.
arg.name: Project name.
arg.about: What it is and what problem it solves, in one sentence.
arg.ui: The project has a user interface.
arg.no_ui: The project has no user interface.
arg.slug: Short kebab-case name for the change.
arg.title: PR title, a Conventional Commit in English of 72 characters or less. Defaults to the plan's goal when that fits.
arg.draft: Open the PR as a draft.
menu.title: What do you want to do today?
menu.in_agent: This happens in your agent: open a session and use /gait.
install.foreign: {path} exists and was not created by Gait. Use --force to replace it.
install.current: The Claude Code adapter is up to date.
install.done: Claude Code adapter installed ({count} files). Open a new session and use /gait.
doctor.hint_install: Run `gait install` to install or update the adapter.
doctor.hint_generic: Run `gait install --agent generic` to update the block.
doctor.hint_hooks: Hooks are activated by `gait init` or `gait adopt`.
init.intro: Gait will set up the project. Follow the steps below:
init.name: Project name
init.about.title: What it is
init.about.help: What it does and what problem it solves, in one sentence.
init.stack.title: Stack and commands
init.stack.help: Leave empty what does not apply.
init.ui: Does it have a user interface?
init.exists: {path} already exists. Use `gait adopt` for an existing repo.
start.intro: Gait will create the change's branch and plan.
start.bad_slug: Use kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
start.no_repo: This is not a git repo.
continue.none: There is no plan on this branch.
continue.all_done: Every step is done. Continue with verification or delivery.
finish.no_plan: There is no plan on this branch.
finish.on_main: You are on {branch}: the PR comes from the change's branch.
finish.check_failed: Fix the above before opening the PR.
finish.bad_title: PR title must be a Conventional Commit of {max} characters or less, like "feat(menu): add sold-out badge". Got: {title}. Pass --title.
cmd.tracker: Show or configure the repo's tracker.
cmd.ticket: List, show or comment on tracker tickets.
arg.tracker_action: set or login; empty shows the configuration.
arg.project: Tracker project, e.g. the Jira key.
tracker.login_hint: Store your token with `gait tracker login`; it stays in the system keychain, never in files.
tracker.login_failed: Could not store the token in the system keychain.
tracker.login_done: Token stored in the system keychain.
ticket.none: This repo has no tracker. The change starts from what the dev describes.
ticket.manual: Manual tracker: ask the dev to paste the ticket.
ticket.jira-agent: Tracker through an agent: ask the company's Jira agent for the tickets.
ticket.login: The token is missing. Run `gait tracker login`.
arg.inventory: Only print the inventory, change nothing.
adopt.no_commits: The repo has no commits yet. Use `gait init`.
adopt.dirty: There are uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them before adopting.
adopt.hooks_kept: The repo already uses hooks in {path}; they were left alone. Add Gait's checks there.
adopt.workflow_kept: {path} already existed and was not replaced.
adopt.done: Branch {branch} with the Gait base and the plan at {path}.
adopt.next: Next: open your agent, use /gait and choose continue. The plan condenses the old docs and asks you to approve what gets deleted.
arg.limit: How many merged PRs to read.
arg.json: One row per change, as JSON.
report.empty: No merged PRs with a Gait plan yet.
check.broken_link: {path} links to {target}, which does not exist.
